notes: Anticoagulation monitoring and osteoporosis. Synthetic, invented speakers.

cases.title: Warfarin: fixed night dose, INR Fridays, bleeding warnings
lines: Doctor: His INR is steady at two point five, so the tablet stays as it is.
Doctor: Take warfarin one tablet at night, the same hour every night.
Nurse: Do not miss the warfarin tablet, and never double up if a day is forgotten.
Doctor: Avoid the green leafy vegetables in big portions, keep the salad steady instead.
Nurse: Please get the INR done every Friday at the same lab, and bring the book here.
Nurse: Make sure to call us at once if there is blood in the urine, a black stool or a knock on the head.
Doctor: Please note the new dose on the chart, and keep the tablet box in the locked drawer.
Doctor: No ibuprofen, no aspirin and no herbal mixes with this tablet.
Doctor: Come back after ten days for the INR, we cannot leave it longer than three weeks.

cases.title: Osteoporosis: weekly bisphosphonate technique, calcium, night light
lines: Doctor: Her bone is thin and there is a fresh fracture, so today we add a bone tablet.
Doctor: Take the alendronate 70 mg once a week, on Wednesday morning.
Nurse: Make sure she swallows the tablet standing upright, not leaning back.
Nurse: She must not lie down for thirty minutes after the tablet, so keep the glass of water beside the chair.
Doctor: Take calcium 500 mg and vitamin D 800 IU with breakfast every day.
Doctor: Do not take the calcium with the thyroid tablet, keep a four hour gap.
Nurse: Wear the non-slip slippers indoors, and put a light on in the corridor at night.
Doctor: Come back in six weeks, and bring the last bone scan report with you.
Doctor: The same calcium tablet is for her husband Sunil, so he must take it after food.
